stops.detail: The Natural Park of Cape of Creus (officially in Catalan: Natural Parc of Cap de Creus) is a Spanish protected space situated at the most northeast point of the Iberian peninsula, in the province of Gerona, at the north-eastern end of Catalonia, within the region of Upper Ampurdan.
